question: What would change your mind on Diginex — what's the exit signal?

beats.line: So here's the one that ends it. Diginex said in December that closing Resulticks depends on debt financing, without further equity dilution.
beats.headline: DEBT, NOT EQUITY
beats.action: A large halftone contract document drops onto open ground; a rubber stamp presses down once and lifts, leaving the sheet flat and held.
beats.delivery: [presenting to camera] So here's the one that ends it. Diginex said in December that closing Resulticks depends on debt financing, without further equity dilution.
beats.narration: So here's the one that ends it. Diginex said in December that closing Resulticks depends on debt financing, without further equity dilution. If that falls through — a raise above twenty percent dilution, or no deal at all — the platform thesis dies. The whole one point five billion bet hinges on it.

beats.line: Now, two things to watch in the numbers.
